source.text: οἱ κύριοι, τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ.

records.literal_gloss: The masters, the just and the fairness to the slaves grant, knowing that also you have a Master in heaven.

en.L: Masters, grant your slaves what is just and fair, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
en.B: Masters, give your slaves what is right and fair, because you know that you too have a Master in heaven.
en.R: Masters, treat your slaves in a way that is right and fair. Remember that you also have a Master, the Lord in heaven.

es.L: Amos, {{plural_you:concedan|conceded}} a los esclavos lo justo y la equidad, sabiendo que también {{plural_you:ustedes tienen|vosotros tenéis}} un Amo en [el] cielo.
es.B: Amos, {{plural_you:den|dad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} esclavos lo que es justo y equitativo, pues {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que también {{plural_you:ustedes tienen|vosotros tenéis}} un Amo en el cielo.
es.R: Amos, {{plural_you:traten|tratad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} esclavos de manera justa y equitativa. {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} que también {{plural_you:ustedes tienen|vosotros tenéis}} un Amo: el Señor que está en el cielo.

fr.L: Maîtres, accordez à [vos] esclaves ce qui est juste et équitable, sachant que vous aussi, vous avez un Maître dans le ciel.
fr.B: Maîtres, donnez à vos esclaves ce qui est juste et équitable, car vous savez que vous aussi, vous avez un Maître dans le ciel.
fr.R: Maîtres, traitez vos esclaves d’une manière juste et équitable. Souvenez-vous que vous aussi, vous avez un Maître : le Seigneur qui est dans le ciel.

sw.L: Mabwana, wapeni watumwa yaliyo ya haki na ya usawa, mkijua kwamba ninyi pia mna Bwana mbinguni.
sw.B: Mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu haki na usawa, kwa sababu mnajua kwamba ninyi pia mna Bwana mbinguni.
sw.R: Mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu kwa haki na kwa usawa. Kumbukeni kwamba ninyi pia mna Bwana wenu, aliye mbinguni.

vi.L: Những người làm chủ, hãy ban cho các nô lệ [của mình] điều công chính và công bằng, vì biết rằng anh chị em cũng có một Chủ ở trên trời.
vi.B: Những người làm chủ, hãy đối đãi với nô lệ mình cách ngay thẳng và công bằng, vì biết rằng chính anh chị em cũng có một Chủ ở trên trời.
vi.R: Những người làm chủ, hãy đối xử với nô lệ của mình cách đúng đắn và công bằng. Hãy nhớ rằng anh chị em cũng có một Chủ, là Chúa ở trên trời.

ko.L: 주인 여러분, 노예들에게 의롭고 공평한 것을 베푸십시오. 여러분에게도 하늘에 주인이 계신 줄을 알기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주인 여러분, 노예들에게 옳고 공정한 것을 주십시오. 여러분에게도 하늘에 주인이 계시다는 것을 알고 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 주인 여러분, 노예들을 옳고 공정하게 대하십시오. 여러분에게도 주인이 계시다는 것을 기억하십시오. 그분은 하늘에 계신 주님이십니다.

pt.L: Senhores, concedam aos [seus] escravos o que é justo e igual, sabendo que vocês também têm um Senhor no céu.
pt.B: Senhores, deem aos seus escravos o que é justo e equitativo, porque vocês sabem que também têm um Senhor no céu.
pt.R: Senhores, tratem os seus escravos de um jeito justo e correto. Lembrem-se de que vocês também têm um Senhor, que está no céu.

am.L: ጌቶች ሆይ፣ እናንተም ደግሞ በሰማይ ጌታ እንዳላችሁ እያወቃችሁ ለባሪያዎቻችሁ ቅን የሆነውንና ሚዛናዊውን ስጡ።
am.B: ጌቶች ሆይ፣ እናንተም በሰማይ ጌታ እንዳላችሁ ስለምታውቁ ለባሪያዎቻችሁ ትክክልና ፍትሐዊ የሆነውን ስጡ።
am.R: ጌቶች ሆይ፣ ባሪያዎቻችሁን በትክክለኛና ፍትሐዊ በሆነ መንገድ ያዙአቸው። እናንተም ጌታ እንዳላችሁ አስታውሱ፤ እርሱም በሰማይ ያለው ጌታ ነው።

decisions.choice: what is just and fair: what is right, and what treats them as equals before God
decisions.reason: δίκαιον is what is just; ἰσότητα means equality or fairness. Masters owe their slaves more than the law demanded: fair treatment, as people who stand on the same level before the one Lord (3:11, 3:25).

decisions.choice: masters, and a Master in heaven: Christ, the Lord of masters and slaves alike
decisions.reason: The same word, κύριος, names the masters and their Master. They are answerable to Christ just as their slaves are (3:22-24; Ephesians 6:9).

decisions.choice: this verse completes the words to slaves and masters
decisions.reason: The chapter division falls in the middle of the household rules; this verse belongs with 3:22-25.

decisions.choice: masters; a Master in heaven
decisions.reason: "Masters" for the owners, as in 3:22, and "Master" with a capital for Christ, to keep the play on the one Greek word (m2). Readable adds "the Lord" so the reader knows who is meant.

decisions.choice: amos; un Amo en el cielo
alternatives: señores; un Señor en el cielo
decisions.reason: "Amo" is the plain word for a slave's owner, and the capital on "Amo" for Christ keeps the play on the one Greek word (m2). "Señores" would echo "Señor" but reads as a polite title rather than as owners. Readable adds "el Señor" so the reader knows who is meant.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the church in the plural throughout. Each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain).

decisions.choice: maîtres ... un Maître
decisions.reason: One Greek word names the owners and Christ (m2). In 3:22 French says "maîtres" and "le Seigneur", but here the point is that the masters have a master too, so French repeats "maître", with a capital for Christ, as the English does; Readable adds who he is.

decisions.choice: mabwana; Bwana mbinguni
decisions.reason: Swahili "bwana" means both a master of slaves and the Lord, so "mabwana" and "Bwana" keep the play on the one Greek word (m2) without help. Readable needs no added explanation, since "Bwana aliye mbinguni" already names the Lord.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as in 3:22: Paul speaks to owners about people they actually owned (m2, m3), and "servant" would change the meaning for modern readers (style guide).

decisions.choice: "những người làm chủ ... một Chủ ở trên trời"; Readable adds "là Chúa"
decisions.reason: The same Greek word names the masters and their Master (m2). Vietnamese can keep the play with one word, "chủ", capitalised for Christ; Readable then says who that Master is. "Nô lệ" stays at every level, as in 3:22.

decisions.choice: "주인 여러분" for the owners and "하늘에 ... 주인이 계신" for Christ; "노예들" at every level
decisions.reason: The same Greek word names the masters and their Master (the meaning decision). Korean keeps the play by using "주인" for both, and the honorific "계신", "계시다" shows that the Master in heaven is the Lord; Readable adds "주님" so the reader knows who is meant. "노예" as in 3:22: owners are told how to treat people they actually owned.

decisions.choice: Senhores; escravos; um Senhor no céu
decisions.reason: As in 3:22: "escravos" at every level, since Paul speaks to owners about people they owned; "senhores" for the owners and "Senhor" with a capital for Christ keep the play on the one word (m2). Readable needs no added "the Lord", as the English does, because Portuguese "Senhor" already says it.

source.text: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε, γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ, προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου, λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι’ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι, ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

records.literal_gloss: In the prayer persist, keeping alert in it with thanksgiving, \v 3 praying at the same time also for us, that the God may open to us a door of the word, to speak the mystery of the Christ, because of which also I have been bound, \v 4 so that I may make it clear as it is necessary for me to speak.

en.L: Persist in prayer, keeping alert in it with thanksgiving, \v 3 praying at the same time for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, for which I am also bound, \v 4 so that I may make it clear, as I must speak.
en.B: Keep on praying, and stay alert as you pray, giving thanks. \v 3 Pray for us too, that God will open a door for our message, so that we can tell the mystery of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, which is why I am in chains. \v 4 Pray that I may make it clear, as I ought to.
en.R: Never stop praying. Stay awake and alert when you pray, and always thank God. \v 3 Pray for us too. Ask God to give us a chance to tell people the message, the mystery about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} that God has now made known. It is because I told this message that I am a prisoner now. \v 4 Pray that I will explain it clearly, the way I should.

es.L: {{plural_you:Perseveren|Perseverad}} en la oración, velando en ella con acción de gracias, \v 3 orando a la vez también por nosotros, para que Dios nos abra una puerta para la palabra, para hablar el misterio del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, por el cual también estoy atado, \v 4 para que lo dé a conocer con claridad, como me es necesario hablar.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} orando con constancia, y {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} alerta al orar, dando gracias. \v 3 {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} también por nosotros, para que Dios nos abra una puerta para el mensaje, a fin de que podamos anunciar el misterio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, por el cual estoy encadenado. \v 4 {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que yo lo dé a conocer con claridad, como debo hacerlo.
es.R: Nunca {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} de orar. {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} despiertos y atentos cuando {{plural_you:oren|oréis}}, y {{plural_you:den|dad}} siempre gracias a Dios. \v 3 {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} también por nosotros. {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} a Dios que nos dé la oportunidad de contar a la gente el mensaje, el misterio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, el plan secreto que Dios ahora ha dado a conocer. Estoy preso ahora precisamente porque anuncié este mensaje. \v 4 {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que yo lo explique con claridad, como debo hacerlo.

fr.L: Persévérez dans la prière, veillant en elle avec reconnaissance, \v 3 priant en même temps pour nous aussi, afin que Dieu nous ouvre une porte pour la parole, pour dire le mystère du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, à cause duquel aussi je suis enchaîné, \v 4 afin que je le fasse connaître clairement, comme il faut que j’en parle.
fr.B: Continuez à prier avec persévérance, et restez vigilants dans la prière, en rendant grâce. \v 3 Priez aussi pour nous : que Dieu ouvre une porte à notre message, pour que nous puissions annoncer le mystère du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, à cause duquel je suis dans les chaînes. \v 4 Priez pour que je le fasse connaître clairement, comme je dois le faire.
fr.R: Ne cessez jamais de prier. Restez éveillés et attentifs quand vous priez, et remerciez toujours Dieu. \v 3 Priez aussi pour nous. Demandez à Dieu de nous donner l’occasion d’annoncer le message aux gens, le mystère du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} que Dieu a maintenant fait connaître. C’est parce que j’ai annoncé ce message que je suis maintenant prisonnier. \v 4 Priez pour que je l’explique clairement, comme je le dois.

sw.L: Dumuni katika maombi, mkikesha ndani yake kwa shukrani, \v 3 mkituombea sisi pia wakati huo huo, ili Mungu atufungulie mlango wa neno, tuseme siri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ambayo kwa sababu yake pia nimefungwa, \v 4 ili niiweke wazi kama inavyonipasa kusema.
sw.B: Endeleeni kuomba kwa bidii, na mkeshe mnapoomba, huku mkishukuru. \v 3 Tuombeeni sisi pia, ili Mungu atufungulie mlango kwa ajili ya ujumbe wetu, tuweze kutangaza siri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}; ndiyo sababu niko katika minyororo. \v 4 Ombeni ili niieleze wazi kama inavyonipasa.
sw.R: Msiache kamwe kuomba. Kesheni na kuwa macho mnapoomba, na mshukuru Mungu siku zote. \v 3 Tuombeeni sisi pia. Mwombeni Mungu atupe nafasi ya kuwaambia watu ujumbe wake, yaani siri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ambayo sasa Mungu ameifunua. Mimi niko gerezani sasa kwa sababu nilihubiri ujumbe huu. \v 4 Ombeni ili niueleze waziwazi, kama ninavyopaswa.

vi.L: Hãy bền lòng trong sự cầu nguyện, tỉnh thức trong đó với sự tạ ơn, \v 3 đồng thời cũng cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi, để Đức Chúa Trời mở cho chúng tôi một cánh cửa cho lời, để nói ra sự mầu nhiệm của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, mà vì đó tôi cũng đang bị xiềng xích, \v 4 để tôi bày tỏ sự mầu nhiệm ấy cách rõ ràng, như tôi phải nói.
vi.B: Hãy kiên trì cầu nguyện, và hãy tỉnh thức khi cầu nguyện, với lòng tạ ơn. \v 3 Cũng hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi, để Đức Chúa Trời mở một cánh cửa cho sứ điệp của chúng tôi, để chúng tôi có thể rao truyền sự mầu nhiệm của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là lý do khiến tôi đang bị xiềng xích. \v 4 Hãy cầu nguyện để tôi bày tỏ sự mầu nhiệm ấy cách rõ ràng, như tôi phải làm.
vi.R: Đừng bao giờ ngừng cầu nguyện. Hãy luôn tỉnh táo và tỉnh thức khi cầu nguyện, và hãy luôn cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời. \v 3 Cũng hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi. Hãy xin Đức Chúa Trời cho chúng tôi cơ hội để nói cho người ta biết sứ điệp, là sự mầu nhiệm về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà Đức Chúa Trời nay đã bày tỏ. Chính vì đã rao truyền sứ điệp này mà bây giờ tôi đang bị tù. \v 4 Hãy cầu nguyện để tôi giải thích sứ điệp ấy cách rõ ràng, như tôi phải làm.

ko.L: 기도에 힘쓰고, 감사하는 가운데 기도하며 깨어 있으십시오. \v 3 동시에 우리를 위해서도 기도하여, 하나님께서 우리에게 말씀의 문을 열어 주셔서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 비밀을 말하게 해 주시기를 [구하십시오]. 나는 이 [비밀] 때문에 매여 있기도 합니다. \v 4 [그리하여] 내가 마땅히 말해야 할 대로 그것을 분명히 드러내게 하시기를 [구하십시오].
ko.B: 꾸준히 기도하십시오. 기도할 때 깨어 있으며 감사하십시오. \v 3 우리를 위해서도 기도해 주십시오. 하나님께서 말씀을 전할 문을 우리에게 열어 주셔서, 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 비밀을 전할 수 있게 해 달라고 기도해 주십시오. 나는 이 비밀 때문에 지금 사슬에 매여 있습니다. \v 4 내가 마땅히 해야 할 대로 그 비밀을 분명하게 드러낼 수 있도록 기도해 주십시오.
ko.R: 절대로 기도를 멈추지 마십시오. 기도할 때는 깨어서 정신을 차리고, 언제나 하나님께 감사하십시오. \v 3 우리를 위해서도 기도해 주십시오. 하나님께서 우리에게 사람들에게 말씀을 전할 기회를 주시도록 구해 주십시오. 그 말씀은 하나님께서 이제 알려 주신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 관한 비밀입니다. 내가 지금 갇혀 있는 것도 바로 이 말씀을 전했기 때문입니다. \v 4 내가 마땅히 해야 할 대로 그것을 분명하게 설명할 수 있도록 기도해 주십시오.

pt.L: Perseverem na oração, vigiando nela com ação de graças, \v 3 orando ao mesmo tempo também por nós, para que Deus nos abra uma porta para a palavra, para anunciarmos o mistério do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, pelo qual também estou acorrentado, \v 4 para que eu o torne manifesto, como devo falar.
pt.B: Não deixem de orar, e fiquem atentos enquanto oram, dando graças. \v 3 Orem também por nós, para que Deus abra uma porta para a nossa mensagem, a fim de que possamos anunciar o mistério {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, que é a razão por que estou acorrentado. \v 4 Orem para que eu o torne claro, como devo fazer.
pt.R: Nunca parem de orar. Estejam acordados e atentos quando orarem, e sempre agradeçam a Deus. \v 3 Orem por nós também. Peçam a Deus que nos dê uma oportunidade de anunciar às pessoas a mensagem, o mistério sobre {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que Deus agora deu a conhecer. É por ter anunciado essa mensagem que agora estou preso. \v 4 Orem para que eu a explique com clareza, como devo fazer.

am.L: በጸሎት ጽኑ፤ በምስጋናም በእርሱ ትጉ፤ \v 3 እንዲሁም በዚያው ጊዜ ስለ እኛ እየጸለያችሁ፣ {{christos:የክርስቶስን|የመሲሑን}} ምሥጢር እንድንናገር እግዚአብሔር የቃልን በር እንዲከፍትልን [ለምኑ]፤ ስለ እርሱም ደግሞ ታስሬአለሁ፤ \v 4 ይህም መናገር እንደሚገባኝ እንድገልጠው ነው።
am.B: ሳታቋርጡ ጸልዩ፤ ስትጸልዩም ንቁ፤ አመስግኑም። \v 3 ስለ እኛም ደግሞ ጸልዩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለመልእክታችን በር እንዲከፍትልንና {{christos:የክርስቶስን|የመሲሑን}} ምሥጢር እንድንናገር ጸልዩ፤ የታሰርኩትም ስለዚሁ ነው። \v 4 እንደሚገባኝም ግልጽ አድርጌ እንድናገረው ጸልዩ።
am.R: መጸለይን ፈጽሞ አታቋርጡ። ስትጸልዩ ንቁና ትጉ፤ ሁልጊዜም እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ። \v 3 ስለ እኛም ጸልዩ። እግዚአብሔር ለሰዎች መልእክቱን የምንነግርበትን ዕድል እንዲሰጠን ለምኑት፤ ይህ መልእክት እግዚአብሔር አሁን ያስታወቀው ስለ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ያለው ምሥጢር ነው። አሁን እስረኛ የሆንኩት ይህን መልእክት ስለ ተናገርኩ ነው። \v 4 በሚገባኝ መንገድ በግልጽ እንዳስረዳው ጸልዩ።

decisions.choice: persist: keep at it, refuse to give up
decisions.reason: προσκαρτερέω means to hold fast to something and keep at it, as the first believers did in prayer (Acts 1:14; 2:42).

decisions.choice: keeping alert: awake and watchful
decisions.reason: γρηγορέω means to stay awake. Jesus told his disciples to keep awake and pray (Mark 14:38), and the word also points to watching for his coming (1 Thessalonians 5:6).

decisions.choice: open a door for the word: give an opportunity to preach
decisions.reason: An open door is a picture for an opportunity God gives to speak the gospel (1 Corinthians 16:9; 2 Corinthians 2:12). Paul asks for that, not first for his release.

decisions.choice: us: Paul and his fellow workers
decisions.reason: Paul asks prayer for "us", his whole team, then speaks of himself: "I am bound", "I may make it clear".

decisions.choice: I am bound: Paul writes as a prisoner
decisions.reason: δέδεμαι means to be bound or in chains. Paul is in custody because of the gospel (4:10, 4:18; compare Philippians 1:13 and Ephesians 6:20). The letter does not say where he was held.

decisions.choice: so that I may make it clear: the purpose of the open door
alternatives: a second request, alongside the first
decisions.reason: ἵνα φανερώσω says what Paul wants to do with the opportunity: make the mystery plain, "as I must", the task given him (1:25-27).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: give us a chance to tell people the message, the mystery about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} that God has now made known
alternatives: open a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ
decisions.reason: Readable explains the open door (m3) and recalls what the mystery is (1:26-27).

decisions.choice: Pray that I may make it clear (B); Pray that I will explain it clearly (R)
alternatives: so that I may make it clear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable start a new sentence and repeat "pray" so the request is plain.

decisions.choice: el misterio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, el plan secreto que Dios ahora ha dado a conocer
decisions.reason: "Misterio" is kept at every level as the letter's key term (1:26-27; 2:2); where the English Readable says "secret", the Spanish Readable keeps "misterio" and explains it as "el plan secreto" that God has now made known.

decisions.choice: du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, "mystère" at every level, and the deity_pronoun span on pronouns for God or Christ, as set out in chapter 1 (for this chapter)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choices of 1:1, 1:9 and 1:26 hold here: the article stays outside the title span, and "mystère" is kept at Readable too, with what it is recalled in plain words.

decisions.choice: siri
decisions.reason: Swahili has one word, "siri", for both a secret and a mystery, so it serves at every level. Paul's mystery is a secret God has now revealed (1:26-27), which "siri" can carry; Readable adds "ambayo sasa Mungu ameifunua". "Fumbo" is a riddle or puzzle, which would suggest something still unclear.

decisions.choice: "sự mầu nhiệm" at every level, as in 1:26 and 2:2
decisions.reason: The key term, recorded once for this chapter. Readable reminds the reader that God has now made it known, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" for Paul and his fellow workers, then "tôi"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say whether "we" includes the hearers. Here it does not: Paul asks prayer for himself and his team (m4), so "chúng tôi", the exclusive form, as through the letter.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, through this chapter, with no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As in the earlier chapters: Korean has no article, so the alternative is plain "메시아", and the Korean text has no deity_pronoun spans, because there are no capitals for the setting to change. God and Christ take the honorific -시- and 께서 at every level.

source.text: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω, τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι.

records.literal_gloss: In wisdom walk toward those outside, the time buying up.

en.L: Walk in wisdom toward those outside, buying up the time.
en.B: Live wisely with those outside the church, making the most of every opportunity.
en.R: Be wise in the way you live with people who are not believers. Use every chance you get to do good.

es.L: {{plural_you:Anden|Andad}} en sabiduría hacia los de afuera, rescatando el tiempo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} con sabiduría en el trato con los que están fuera de la iglesia, y no {{plural_you:desperdicien|desperdiciéis}} ninguna oportunidad.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} sabios en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} manera de vivir con la gente que no cree. {{plural_you:Usen|Usad}} cada ocasión que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} para hacer el bien.

fr.L: Marchez dans la sagesse envers ceux du dehors, rachetant le moment favorable.
fr.B: Conduisez-vous avec sagesse envers ceux qui sont hors de l’Église, en saisissant chaque occasion.
fr.R: Soyez sages dans votre façon de vivre avec ceux qui ne croient pas. Profitez de chaque occasion pour faire le bien.

sw.L: Enendeni katika hekima kuelekea wale walio nje, mkiununua wakati.
sw.B: Ishini kwa hekima mnapohusiana na watu walio nje ya kanisa, mkitumia vizuri kila nafasi.
sw.R: Kuweni na hekima katika jinsi mnavyoishi na watu wasioamini. Tumieni kila nafasi mnayopata kutenda mema.

vi.L: Hãy bước đi trong sự khôn ngoan đối với những người ở ngoài, mua lấy thời cơ.
vi.B: Hãy sống khôn ngoan với những người ở ngoài Hội Thánh, tận dụng mọi cơ hội.
vi.R: Hãy khôn ngoan trong cách sống với những người chưa tin. Hãy dùng mọi cơ hội mình có để làm điều tốt.

ko.L: 바깥에 있는 사람들을 향하여 지혜 가운데 걸으며, 시간을 사들이십시오.
ko.B: 교회 밖에 있는 사람들에게 지혜롭게 처신하고, 모든 기회를 최대한 활용하십시오.
ko.R: 믿지 않는 사람들과 함께 살아갈 때 지혜롭게 행동하십시오. 선한 일을 할 수 있는 기회가 오면 하나도 놓치지 마십시오.

pt.L: Andem em sabedoria para com os de fora, resgatando o tempo.
pt.B: Vivam com sabedoria no trato com os de fora da igreja, aproveitando bem cada oportunidade.
pt.R: Sejam sábios no modo como vivem entre as pessoas que não creem em Jesus. Aproveitem cada chance que tiverem para fazer o bem.

am.L: በውጭ ባሉት ዘንድ ጊዜውን እየገዛችሁ በጥበብ ተመላለሱ።
am.B: ከቤተ ክርስቲያን ውጭ ካሉ ሰዎች ጋር በጥበብ ኑሩ፤ ያገኛችሁትን ዕድል ሁሉ በሚገባ ተጠቀሙበት።
am.R: አማኞች ካልሆኑ ሰዎች ጋር ስትኖሩ ጥበበኞች ሁኑ። መልካም ለማድረግ የምታገኙትን ዕድል ሁሉ ተጠቀሙበት።

decisions.choice: those outside: people who are not believers
decisions.reason: "Those outside" is a common way of speaking of people outside the church (1 Corinthians 5:12-13; 1 Thessalonians 4:12). How believers live is seen by them.

decisions.choice: buying up the time: making the most of each opportunity
decisions.reason: ἐξαγοράζω means to buy up, to buy out. With καιρὸν, the right or opportune time, it means seizing every opening (Ephesians 5:16). In Daniel 2:8 the same phrase means trying to gain time, but that sense does not fit here.

decisions.choice: Live (B); Be wise in the way you live (R)
decisions.reason: "Walk" is a figure for how one lives; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: outside the church; making the most of every opportunity (B); people who are not believers; every chance you get to do good (R)
alternatives: those outside; buying up the time
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "those outside" are and what the idiom means (m1, m2). Readable's "to do good" names what the opportunity is for.

decisions.choice: rescatando el tiempo
decisions.reason: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι is to buy up or buy out. "Comprar tiempo" in Spanish means to gain time by delay, the sense m2 sets aside, and "redimir" is kept for redemption (1:14). "Rescatar" keeps the picture of buying something back.

decisions.choice: rachetant le moment favorable (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the right or opportune time, not time in general (m2). "Racheter le temps" would suggest making up for lost time, so Literal says "le moment favorable" and Balanced and Readable say "chaque occasion".

decisions.choice: mkiununua wakati
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of buying (m2). "Kukomboa" is the familiar wording, but "ukombozi" is kept for redemption (1:14), a different Greek word.

decisions.choice: "mua lấy thời cơ" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of buying up and the sense of the right moment in "thời cơ" (m2); "thì giờ" would be time in general. Balanced and Readable give the meaning.

decisions.choice: resgatando o tempo
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the buying picture of the verb with "resgatar", to buy back, as the English Literal says "buying up". "Comprar tempo" is avoided: in Portuguese it means to stall for time, the sense m2 rules out. Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means.

decisions.choice: ጊዜውን እየገዛችሁ (buying up the time)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the market picture of buying up the time (meaning decision m2) with the everyday verb "መግዛት"; the familiar "ዘመኑን ዋጁ" is the wording of the 1962 Bible. Balanced and Readable say "make the most of every opportunity".

source.text: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι, ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος, εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: The word of you always in grace, with salt seasoned, to know how it is necessary for you each one to answer.

en.L: [Let] your speech [be] always with graciousness, seasoned with salt, so that you know how you ought to answer each one.
en.B: Let your conversation always be gracious and seasoned with salt, so that you know how to answer each person.
en.R: Always speak in a kind and pleasant way, and make what you say interesting, like food with salt in it. Then you will know how to give a good answer to anyone who asks you something.

es.L: [Que] {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} palabra [sea] siempre con gracia, sazonada con sal, para saber cómo {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} responder a cada uno.
es.B: Que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} conversación sea siempre amable y sazonada con sal, para que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cómo responder a cada persona.
es.R: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} siempre de manera amable y agradable, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} que lo que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} sea interesante, como la comida que tiene sal. Así {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} dar una buena respuesta a cualquiera que {{plural_you:les|os}} pregunte algo.

fr.L: [Que] votre parole [soit] toujours avec grâce, assaisonnée de sel, pour savoir comment vous devez répondre à chacun.
fr.B: Que votre conversation soit toujours aimable et assaisonnée de sel, pour que vous sachiez comment répondre à chacun.
fr.R: Parlez toujours d’une façon aimable et agréable, et rendez vos paroles intéressantes, comme un plat bien salé. Alors vous saurez donner une bonne réponse à toute personne qui vous pose une question.

sw.L: Usemi wenu [uwe] siku zote kwa neema, uliokolezwa kwa chumvi, ili mjue jinsi mnavyopaswa kumjibu kila mmoja.
sw.B: Mazungumzo yenu yawe ya upole na ya kupendeza siku zote, yamekolezwa kwa chumvi, ili mjue jinsi ya kumjibu kila mtu.
sw.R: Siku zote semeni kwa upole na kwa maneno mazuri, na yafanyeni maneno yenu yawe na ladha, kama chakula kilichotiwa chumvi. Ndipo mtajua jinsi ya kumjibu vizuri kila mtu anayewauliza jambo.

vi.L: [Hãy để] lời nói của anh chị em luôn luôn có duyên, được nêm bằng muối, để anh chị em biết phải đáp lời mỗi người thế nào.
vi.B: Hãy để lời nói của anh chị em luôn luôn nhã nhặn và có duyên, như được nêm muối, để anh chị em biết cách trả lời từng người.
vi.R: Hãy luôn ăn nói tử tế và dễ nghe, và làm cho lời mình nói được thú vị, như thức ăn có nêm muối. Khi đó anh chị em sẽ biết cách trả lời tốt cho bất cứ ai hỏi mình điều gì.

ko.L: 여러분의 말은 언제나 은혜롭고 소금으로 맛을 낸 것이 되게 하여, 각 사람에게 어떻게 대답해야 할지 알도록 하십시오.
ko.B: 여러분의 말은 언제나 따뜻하고 품위 있게, 소금으로 맛을 낸 듯이 하십시오. 그러면 각 사람에게 어떻게 대답해야 할지 알게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 언제나 친절하고 부드럽게 말하십시오. 음식에 소금을 넣듯이, 여러분의 말도 듣기 좋고 흥미롭게 하십시오. 그러면 누가 무엇을 묻든지 좋은 대답을 해 줄 수 있을 것입니다.

pt.L: [Que] a palavra de vocês [seja] sempre amável, temperada com sal, para saberem como devem responder a cada um.
pt.B: Que a conversa de vocês seja sempre agradável e temperada com sal, para que saibam como responder a cada pessoa.
pt.R: Falem sempre de um jeito gentil e agradável, e façam com que o que vocês dizem seja interessante, como comida com sal. Assim vocês vão saber dar uma boa resposta a qualquer pessoa que fizer uma pergunta a vocês.

am.L: ንግግራችሁ ሁልጊዜ በጸጋ፣ በጨው የተቀመመ [ይሁን]፤ ይኸውም ለእያንዳንዱ እንዴት መመለስ እንደሚገባችሁ እንድታውቁ ነው።
am.B: ንግግራችሁ ሁልጊዜ ሞገስ ያለውና በጨው የተቀመመ ይሁን፤ ይህም ለእያንዳንዱ ሰው እንዴት መልስ መስጠት እንዳለባችሁ እንድታውቁ ነው።
am.R: ሁልጊዜ በደግነትና ደስ በሚያሰኝ መንገድ ተናገሩ። ጨው እንደ ገባበት ምግብ ንግግራችሁ የሚጣፍጥ ይሁን። ያን ጊዜ አንድ ነገር ለሚጠይቃችሁ ሰው ሁሉ መልካም መልስ እንዴት እንደምትሰጡ ታውቃላችሁ።

decisions.choice: with grace: gracious, pleasing and kind
decisions.reason: χάριτι is the word for grace, but in speech it means what is gracious and pleasing, as in Luke 4:22, where people wonder at Jesus' "gracious words". Kind speech also reflects the grace they have received.

decisions.choice: seasoned with salt: lively and worth hearing
decisions.reason: Greek writers spoke of witty, lively talk as salted. Salt also kept food from spoiling, and some take it as speech free from what is rotten (compare 3:8); the main idea is speech with flavor, not dull or bland.

decisions.choice: to know how to answer each one: speech that fits the person
decisions.reason: ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ("each one") means every individual: the right answer depends on who is asking (1 Peter 3:15).

decisions.choice: graciousness (L); gracious (B); kind and pleasant (R)
decisions.reason: The sense here is gracious speech (m1), so the key term "grace" is not used.

decisions.choice: [Let] ... [be]
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb.

decisions.choice: make what you say interesting, like food with salt in it
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: con gracia (L); amable (B, R)
decisions.reason: Spanish "hablar con gracia" means to speak pleasingly, so Literal can keep the word "gracia" in the sense of m1. Balanced and Readable say "amable", as the English leaves the key term aside here.

decisions.choice: avec grâce (L); aimable (B); aimable et agréable (R)
decisions.reason: The sense is gracious, pleasing speech (m1). French "avec grâce" says that naturally at Literal, as of someone who speaks with charm, so the link with the word for grace stays visible there; Balanced and Readable say "aimable", since "gracieuse" would suggest elegance more than kindness.

decisions.choice: kwa neema (L); ya upole na ya kupendeza (B); kwa upole (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "neema", which Swahili also uses of gracious words ("maneno ya neema"). Balanced and Readable say what the speech is like (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "có duyên" (L, B); "tử tế và dễ nghe" (R), not "ân điển"
decisions.reason: The sense here is gracious, pleasing speech (m1), so the key term "ân điển" is not used, as the English does not use "grace". Vietnamese says of pleasant, winning speech that it "có duyên".

decisions.choice: "은혜롭고" (L); "따뜻하고 품위 있게" (B); "친절하고 부드럽게" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word for grace here as gracious, pleasing speech, and the English leaves the key term out. Literal keeps the link with "은혜롭다", which Korean uses of gracious, edifying words; Balanced and Readable say what such speech is like.

decisions.choice: amável (L); agradável (B); gentil e agradável (R)
decisions.reason: m1 says the sense here is gracious, pleasing speech, so, as in the English, the key term "graça" is not used. "Falar com graça" would be natural Portuguese for charming speech, but it would make the key term mean something it does not mean elsewhere in the letter.

decisions.choice: በጸጋ (with grace, L); ሞገስ ያለው (gracious, B); በደግነትና ደስ በሚያሰኝ መንገድ (kindly and pleasantly, R)
decisions.reason: "ጸጋ" is kept for God's grace through the letter; here it is a quality of speech, gracious and pleasing (meaning decision m1), so Literal keeps Paul's word and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: Τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν κυρίῳ, ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν, σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν· πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε.

records.literal_gloss: The things concerning me all will make known to you Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow slave in [the] Lord, \v 8 whom I sent to you for this very [purpose], that you may know the things concerning us and he may encourage the hearts of you, \v 9 with Onesimus the faithful and beloved brother, who is of you; all things to you they will make known, the [things] here.

en.L: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow slave in [the] Lord, will make known to you all the things concerning me. \v 8 I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know the things concerning us and that he may encourage your hearts, \v 9 with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you all the things here.
en.B: Tychicus will tell you all my news. He is a dear brother, a faithful servant and a fellow slave in the Lord. \v 8 I am sending him to you for this very reason, so that you may know how we are and so that he may encourage your hearts. \v 9 He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of your own. They will tell you everything that is happening here.
en.R: Tychicus will tell you all about how I am doing. He is a brother we love. He serves the Lord faithfully, and he is a slave of the Lord, as we are. \v 8 That is why I am sending him to you. I want you to know how we are, and I want him to encourage you. \v 9 Onesimus is coming with him. He is a faithful brother whom we love, and he is from your own town. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

es.L: Tíquico, el amado hermano y fiel servidor y coesclavo en [el] Señor, {{plural_you:les|os}} hará saber todo lo que se refiere a mí. \v 8 Lo envié a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para esto mismo, para que {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} lo que se refiere a nosotros y para que anime {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones, \v 9 con Onésimo, el fiel y amado hermano, que es uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ellos {{plural_you:les|os}} harán saber todo lo de aquí.
es.B: Tíquico {{plural_you:les|os}} contará todas mis noticias. Es un hermano querido, un servidor fiel y, como nosotros, esclavo en el Señor. \v 8 {{plural_you:Se|Os}} lo envío precisamente por esto: para que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cómo estamos y para que anime {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones. \v 9 Va con Onésimo, nuestro fiel y querido hermano, que es uno de los {{plural_you:suyos|vuestros}}. Ellos {{plural_you:les|os}} contarán todo lo que pasa aquí.
es.R: Tíquico {{plural_you:les|os}} contará todo sobre cómo me va. Es un hermano al que amamos. Sirve al Señor con fidelidad, y es esclavo del Señor, igual que nosotros. \v 8 Por eso {{plural_you:se|os}} lo envío. Quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cómo estamos, y quiero que él {{plural_you:los|os}} anime. \v 9 Onésimo va con él. Es un hermano fiel al que amamos, y es de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} propia ciudad. Ellos {{plural_you:les|os}} contarán todo lo que está pasando aquí.

fr.L: Tout ce qui me concerne, Tychique, le frère bien-aimé et fidèle serviteur et compagnon d’esclavage dans le Seigneur, vous le fera connaître. \v 8 Je vous l’ai envoyé pour cela même, afin que vous connaissiez ce qui nous concerne et qu’il encourage vos cœurs, \v 9 avec Onésime, le frère fidèle et bien-aimé, qui est des vôtres. Ils vous feront connaître tout ce qui [se passe] ici.
fr.B: Tychique vous donnera toutes mes nouvelles. C’est un frère cher, un serviteur fidèle et un compagnon d’esclavage dans le Seigneur. \v 8 Je vous l’envoie précisément pour cela, afin que vous sachiez comment nous allons et qu’il encourage vos cœurs. \v 9 Il vient avec Onésime, notre frère fidèle et cher, qui est l’un des vôtres. Ils vous raconteront tout ce qui se passe ici.
fr.R: Tychique vous dira tout sur la façon dont je vais. C’est un frère que nous aimons. Il sert fidèlement le Seigneur, et il est esclave du Seigneur, comme nous. \v 8 C’est pour cela que je vous l’envoie. Je veux que vous sachiez comment nous allons, et je veux qu’il vous encourage. \v 9 Onésime vient avec lui. C’est un frère fidèle que nous aimons, et il est de votre ville. Ils vous raconteront tout ce qui se passe ici.

sw.L: Mambo yangu yote atawajulisha Tikiko, ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu na mtumwa mwenzetu katika Bwana, \v 8 ambaye nimemtuma kwenu kwa ajili ya jambo hili hili, ili mjue mambo yetu na ili aitie nguvu mioyo yenu, \v 9 pamoja na Onesimo, ndugu mwaminifu na mpendwa, aliye wa kwenu. Watawajulisha mambo yote ya hapa.
sw.B: Tikiko atawaeleza habari zangu zote. Yeye ni ndugu mpendwa, mtumishi mwaminifu na mtumwa mwenzetu katika Bwana. \v 8 Ninamtuma kwenu kwa sababu hiyo hasa, ili mjue hali yetu na ili awatie moyo. \v 9 Anakuja pamoja na Onesimo, ndugu yetu mwaminifu na mpendwa, ambaye ni wa kwenu. Watawaeleza yote yanayotendeka huku.
sw.R: Tikiko atawaambia habari zangu zote. Yeye ni ndugu tunayempenda. Anamtumikia Bwana kwa uaminifu, naye ni mtumwa wa Bwana kama sisi. \v 8 Ndiyo sababu ninamtuma kwenu. Nataka mjue hali yetu, na nataka awatie moyo. \v 9 Onesimo anakuja pamoja naye. Yeye ni ndugu mwaminifu tunayempenda, na anatoka katika mji wenu. Wao watawaambia yote yanayotokea huku.

vi.L: Ti-chi-cơ, người anh em yêu dấu, người phục vụ trung tín và bạn đồng nô lệ trong Chúa, sẽ cho anh chị em biết mọi việc về tôi. \v 8 Tôi đã sai anh ấy đến cùng anh chị em vì chính mục đích này, để anh chị em biết những việc về chúng tôi và để anh ấy khích lệ lòng anh chị em, \v 9 cùng với Ô-nê-sim, người anh em trung tín và yêu dấu, là một người trong anh chị em. Họ sẽ cho anh chị em biết mọi việc ở đây.
vi.B: Ti-chi-cơ sẽ kể cho anh chị em mọi tin tức về tôi. Anh ấy là người anh em thân yêu, người phục vụ trung tín và là bạn cùng làm đầy tớ trong Chúa. \v 8 Tôi sai anh ấy đến với anh chị em chính vì lý do này, để anh chị em biết chúng tôi ra sao và để anh ấy khích lệ lòng anh chị em. \v 9 Anh ấy đến cùng với Ô-nê-sim, người anh em trung tín và thân yêu của chúng ta, là người đồng hương với anh chị em. Họ sẽ kể cho anh chị em mọi việc đang xảy ra ở đây.
vi.R: Ti-chi-cơ sẽ kể cho anh chị em biết mọi điều về tình hình của tôi. Anh ấy là người anh em mà chúng tôi yêu mến. Anh ấy trung tín phục vụ Chúa, và cũng là đầy tớ của Chúa như chúng tôi. \v 8 Vì vậy tôi sai anh ấy đến với anh chị em. Tôi muốn anh chị em biết chúng tôi ra sao, và tôi muốn anh ấy khích lệ anh chị em. \v 9 Ô-nê-sim cùng đi với anh ấy. Ô-nê-sim là người anh em trung tín mà chúng tôi yêu mến, và là người ở ngay thành của anh chị em. Họ sẽ kể cho anh chị em mọi việc đang xảy ra ở đây.

ko.L: 나에 관한 모든 일은 두기고가 여러분에게 알려 줄 것입니다. 그는 사랑받는 형제이며, 주님 안에서 신실한 일꾼이고 동료 종입니다. \v 8 내가 그를 바로 이 목적으로 여러분에게 보냈으니, 여러분이 우리의 사정을 알고, 그가 여러분의 마음을 격려하게 하려는 것입니다. \v 9 [그를] 신실하고 사랑받는 형제 오네시모와 함께 [보냈습니다]. 그는 여러분 가운데 한 사람입니다. 그들이 이곳의 모든 일을 여러분에게 알려 줄 것입니다.
ko.B: 두기고가 내 소식을 모두 여러분에게 전해 줄 것입니다. 그는 사랑하는 형제이고, 신실한 일꾼이며, 주님 안에서 함께 섬기는 동료 종입니다. \v 8 내가 바로 이 일 때문에 그를 여러분에게 보냅니다. 여러분이 우리 형편을 알고, 그가 여러분의 마음을 격려하게 하려는 것입니다. \v 9 그는 우리의 신실하고 사랑하는 형제 오네시모와 함께 갑니다. 오네시모는 여러분 가운데 한 사람입니다. 그들이 이곳에서 일어나는 모든 일을 여러분에게 알려 줄 것입니다.
ko.R: 두기고가 내가 어떻게 지내는지 여러분에게 다 이야기해 줄 것입니다. 그는 우리가 사랑하는 형제입니다. 그는 주님을 신실하게 섬기고, 우리처럼 주님의 종입니다. \v 8 그래서 내가 그를 여러분에게 보냅니다. 여러분이 우리가 어떻게 지내는지 알기를 바라고, 그가 여러분에게 용기를 주기를 바랍니다. \v 9 오네시모도 그와 함께 갑니다. 그는 우리가 사랑하는 신실한 형제이며, 여러분의 도시 사람입니다. 그들이 이곳에서 일어나는 일을 모두 여러분에게 이야기해 줄 것입니다.

pt.L: Tíquico, o irmão amado e fiel servo e companheiro de escravidão no Senhor, dará a conhecer a vocês todas as coisas a meu respeito. \v 8 Eu o enviei a vocês para isto mesmo, para que vocês conheçam as coisas a nosso respeito e para que ele encoraje os corações de vocês, \v 9 com Onésimo, o fiel e amado irmão, que é um de vocês. Eles darão a conhecer a vocês todas as coisas daqui.
pt.B: Tíquico vai contar a vocês todas as notícias sobre mim. Ele é um irmão querido, um servo fiel e um companheiro de escravidão no Senhor. \v 8 Estou enviando Tíquico a vocês exatamente por isso, para que saibam como estamos e para que ele encoraje o coração de vocês. \v 9 Ele vai com Onésimo, o nosso fiel e querido irmão, que é um de vocês. Eles vão contar a vocês tudo o que está acontecendo aqui.
pt.R: Tíquico vai contar a vocês tudo sobre como estou. Ele é um irmão que amamos. Ele serve ao Senhor com fidelidade e é escravo do Senhor, como nós. \v 8 É por isso que estou enviando Tíquico a vocês. Quero que vocês saibam como estamos, e quero que ele anime vocês. \v 9 Onésimo vai com ele. Ele é um irmão fiel, a quem amamos, e é da cidade de vocês. Eles vão contar a vocês tudo o que está acontecendo aqui.

am.L: ስለ እኔ ያለውን ሁሉ የተወደደው ወንድም፣ ታማኝ አገልጋይና በጌታ አብሮን ባሪያ የሆነው ቲኪቆስ ያስታውቃችኋል፤ \v 8 ስለ እኛ ያለውን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና ለዚሁ ነገር ወደ እናንተ ላክኩት፤ \v 9 ከእናንተ ወገን ከሆነው ከታማኙና ከተወደደው ወንድም ከአናሲሞስ ጋር [ላክኩት]፤ በዚህ ያለውን ሁሉ ያስታውቋችኋል።
am.B: ቲኪቆስ ስለ እኔ ያለውን ወሬ ሁሉ ይነግራችኋል። እርሱ የተወደደ ወንድም፣ ታማኝ አገልጋይና በጌታ ከእኛ ጋር አብሮ ባሪያ ነው። \v 8 ወደ እናንተ የምልከው እንዴት እንዳለን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያበረታታ ለዚሁ ዓላማ ነው። \v 9 ከእናንተ ወገን ከሆነው ከታማኙና ከተወደደው ወንድማችን ከአናሲሞስ ጋር ይመጣል። በዚህ የሚሆነውን ሁሉ ይነግሯችኋል።
am.R: ቲኪቆስ እንዴት እንዳለሁ ሁሉንም ይነግራችኋል። እርሱ የምንወደው ወንድም ነው። ጌታን በታማኝነት ያገለግላል፤ እንደ እኛም የጌታ ባሪያ ነው። \v 8 ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ለዚህ ነው። እንዴት እንዳለን እንድታውቁ እፈልጋለሁ፤ እንዲያበረታታችሁም እፈልጋለሁ። \v 9 አናሲሞስ ከእርሱ ጋር ይመጣል። እርሱ የምንወደው ታማኝ ወንድም ነው፤ ከእናንተም ከተማ ነው። በዚህ የሚሆነውን ሁሉ ይነግሯችኋል።

decisions.choice: Tychicus: one of Paul's companions from the province of Asia, who carried the letter
decisions.reason: Tychicus was from Asia (Acts 20:4) and is also named as Paul's messenger in Ephesians 6:21-22. "I have sent" is written from the readers' point of view: when they read the letter, he will have arrived with it.

decisions.choice: servant and fellow slave: one who serves, and one who belongs to the same Master
decisions.reason: διάκονος is the word used of Epaphras and of Paul (1:7, 1:23, 1:25). σύνδουλος is the word for "fellow slave" used of Epaphras in 1:7: Tychicus, like Paul, belongs to Christ.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "that you may know the things concerning us"
alternatives: "that he may know the things concerning you"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "that he may know about you". The two readings differ by a few letters in Greek. The SBLGNT's reading matches what Paul says in verses 7 and 9, that Tychicus comes to tell them Paul's news. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: I have sent: the past tense of letters
decisions.reason: ἔπεμψα is past, written from the time the letter will be read, though Tychicus is carrying it. Balanced and Readable say "I am sending".

decisions.choice: Onesimus: a Colossian, very likely the slave for whom Paul wrote to Philemon
decisions.reason: Paul's letter to Philemon asks him to welcome back his slave Onesimus, who has become a believer, "no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a dear brother" (Philemon 10-16). Archippus is named in both letters (verse 17; Philemon 2), so the two letters were most likely sent together. Here Paul calls Onesimus simply "the faithful and beloved brother".

decisions.choice: one of you: from Colossae
decisions.reason: The same words are used of Epaphras in verse 12.

decisions.choice: fellow slave (L, B); a slave of the Lord, as we are (R)
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level: "servant" already renders the other word in this sentence ("a faithful servant"), and the style guide keeps the two words apart (m2).

decisions.choice: I am sending
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the tense natural in English (m4).

decisions.choice: the sentence is divided
decisions.reason: The Greek is one sentence, which ends with a raised dot inside verse 9. Every level divides it so that the people named are easy to follow.

decisions.choice: coesclavo (L); como nosotros, esclavo (B, R)
decisions.reason: σύνδουλος is "fellow slave" (m2). As in the English, "esclavo" stays at every level here, because "servidor" already renders the other word in the same sentence and the two must stay apart. "Coesclavo" is rare, so Balanced and Readable spell it out.

decisions.choice: mtumwa mwenzetu
decisions.reason: "Mjoli" is the older word for a fellow servant and is no longer widely understood; "mtumwa mwenzetu" keeps the key term "mtumwa" (m2). As in the English, "mtumwa" stays at every level here, because "mtumishi" already renders the other word in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "người phục vụ" for diakonos and "bạn cùng làm đầy tớ" (B), "đầy tớ" (R) for syndoulos, as in 1:7
alternatives: "bạn đồng nô lệ" (B, R), as the English keeps "slave"
decisions.reason: The English keeps "slave" here at every level because its "servant" already renders diakonos. Vietnamese uses "người phục vụ" for diakonos (1:23), so "đầy tớ" stays free for doulos at Balanced and Readable, as in 1:7 for Epaphras; Literal keeps "nô lệ".

decisions.choice: "Ti-chi-cơ", "Ô-nê-sim", and the other names of the letter in the Protestant transliterations (Cô-lô-se, Lao-đi-xê, Hi-ê-ra-pô-li, Ê-pháp-ra, A-ri-tạc, Mác, Ba-na-ba, Giu-tu, Lu-ca, Đê-ma, Nim-pha, A-chíp); "anh ấy" for the men Paul sends
decisions.reason: Names follow the tradition the style guide sets for the whole translation. Spellings not in the style guide's list should be checked by a reviewer, Hi-ê-ra-pô-li in particular. "Người anh em" leaves open whether a brother is older or younger, as in the Vietnamese John (1:40).

decisions.choice: "일꾼" and "동료 종" (L, B); "섬기다" and "주님의 종" (R), as for Epaphras in 1:7
decisions.reason: The two words are kept apart as in 1:7: "일꾼" for the one who serves and "종" for the one who belongs to a master. "종" is the style guide's word at every level; "노예" is kept for places where slavery itself is the point, which this is not.

decisions.choice: servo (the first word); companheiro de escravidão (L, B); escravo do Senhor, como nós (R)
decisions.reason: As the English decides here: "servo" already renders the other word in this sentence, so the slave word is kept at every level to keep the two apart (m2). In 1:7, where it stands alone, Balanced and Readable say "companheiro de serviço".

decisions.choice: Tíquico; Onésimo
decisions.reason: The names in their usual Brazilian form, as for Epafras (1:7), Aristarco, Marcos, Barnabé, Justo, Lucas, Demas, Ninfa and Arquipo in the verses that follow.

decisions.choice: ቲኪቆስ (Tychicus); አናሲሞስ (Onesimus)
decisions.reason: The established Amharic Bible forms; "ቲኪቆስ" is the spelling used in Acts 20:4.

decisions.choice: አብሮን ባሪያ (fellow slave, L, B); እንደ እኛም የጌታ ባሪያ (like us a slave of the Lord, R)
decisions.reason: As for Epaphras in 1:7: "ባሪያ" for the doulos word at every level, with "አገልጋይ" kept for diakonos (servant) beside it in the same verse.

source.text: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου, καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρναβᾶ περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς, ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν, καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος, οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς, οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία.

records.literal_gloss: Greets you Aristarchus the fellow prisoner of me, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom you received instructions, if he comes to you, receive him, \v 11 and Jesus the [one] called Justus, the [ones] being of [the] circumcision, these only fellow workers for the kingdom of the God, who have become to me a comfort.

en.L: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions: if he comes to you, welcome him), \v 11 and Jesus who is called Justus. These, of those of the circumcision, [are the] only fellow workers for the kingdom of God, [and they] have been a comfort to me.
en.B: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have had instructions about him: if he comes to you, make him welcome. \v 11 Jesus who is called Justus greets you too. Of all the Jewish believers, these are the only ones working with me for the kingdom of God, and they have been a great comfort to me.
en.R: Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, says hello. So does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told what to do about Mark: if he comes to you, welcome him. \v 11 Jesus, who is also called Justus, says hello too. These three are the only Jewish believers who are working with me to spread the news of God's kingdom. They have been a great comfort to me.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saluda Aristarco, mi compañero de prisión, y Marcos, el primo de Bernabé (acerca del cual {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} instrucciones: si va a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:recíbanlo|recibidlo}}), \v 11 y Jesús, el llamado Justo. Estos, de los de la circuncisión, [son los] únicos colaboradores para el reino de Dios, [y] han sido para mí un consuelo.
es.B: Aristarco, mi compañero de prisión, {{plural_you:les|os}} envía saludos, y también Marcos, el primo de Bernabé. Ya {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} instrucciones acerca de él: si va a {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}}, {{plural_you:recíbanlo|recibidlo}} bien. \v 11 También {{plural_you:les|os}} envía saludos Jesús, el que se llama Justo. De todos los creyentes judíos, solo estos trabajan conmigo por el reino de Dios, y han sido un gran consuelo para mí.
es.R: Aristarco, que está preso conmigo, {{plural_you:les|os}} manda saludos. También Marcos, el primo de Bernabé. Ya {{plural_you:les|os}} dijeron qué hacer con Marcos: si va a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}, {{plural_you:recíbanlo|recibidlo}}. \v 11 Jesús, al que también llaman Justo, {{plural_you:les|os}} manda saludos también. Estos tres son los únicos creyentes judíos que trabajan conmigo para anunciar el reino de Dios. Han sido un gran consuelo para mí.

fr.L: Aristarque, mon compagnon de captivité, vous salue, ainsi que Marc, le cousin de Barnabas (à son sujet vous avez reçu des instructions : s’il vient chez vous, accueillez-le), \v 11 et Jésus appelé Justus. Ceux-ci, parmi ceux de la circoncision, [sont les] seuls collaborateurs pour le royaume de Dieu, [et ils] ont été pour moi un réconfort.
fr.B: Aristarque, mon compagnon de captivité, vous salue, ainsi que Marc, le cousin de Barnabas. Vous avez reçu des instructions à son sujet : s’il vient chez vous, faites-lui bon accueil. \v 11 Jésus, appelé Justus, vous salue aussi. De tous les croyants juifs, ce sont les seuls qui travaillent avec moi pour le royaume de Dieu, et ils ont été pour moi un grand réconfort.
fr.R: Aristarque, qui est en prison avec moi, vous salue. Marc, le cousin de Barnabas, vous salue aussi. On vous a déjà dit ce qu’il faut faire pour Marc : s’il vient chez vous, accueillez-le. \v 11 Jésus, qu’on appelle aussi Justus, vous salue lui aussi. Ces trois-là sont les seuls croyants juifs qui travaillent avec moi pour faire connaître le royaume de Dieu. Ils m’ont beaucoup réconforté.

sw.L: Aristarko, mfungwa mwenzangu, anawasalimu, na Marko, binamu wa Barnaba (ambaye kwa habari zake mlipokea maagizo: akija kwenu, mpokeeni), \v 11 na Yesu aitwaye Yusto. Hawa, kati ya wale wa tohara, [ndio] watenda kazi wenzangu peke yao kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu, [nao] wamekuwa faraja kwangu.
sw.B: Aristarko, mfungwa mwenzangu, anawasalimu, na Marko, binamu wa Barnaba, anawasalimu pia. Mmekwisha kupata maagizo kumhusu: akifika kwenu, mkaribisheni. \v 11 Yesu aitwaye Yusto naye anawasalimu. Kati ya waumini wote walio Wayahudi, hawa ndio pekee wanaofanya kazi pamoja nami kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu, nao wamekuwa faraja kubwa kwangu.
sw.R: Aristarko, aliye gerezani pamoja nami, anawasalimu. Marko, binamu wa Barnaba, anawasalimu pia. Mmekwisha kuambiwa mfanye nini kuhusu Marko: akija kwenu, mkaribisheni. \v 11 Yesu, ambaye pia anaitwa Yusto, anawasalimu pia. Hawa watatu ndio waumini Wayahudi pekee wanaofanya kazi pamoja nami kueneza habari za ufalme wa Mungu. Wamekuwa faraja kubwa kwangu.

vi.L: A-ri-tạc, bạn đồng tù với tôi, chào anh chị em, và Mác, anh em họ của Ba-na-ba (về người này anh chị em đã nhận được lời dặn: nếu anh ấy đến với anh chị em, hãy tiếp đón anh ấy), \v 11 và Giê-xu, cũng gọi là Giu-tu. Trong số những người chịu cắt bì, chỉ có những người này là bạn đồng lao cho vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, [và họ] đã là niềm an ủi cho tôi.
vi.B: A-ri-tạc, bạn cùng bị tù với tôi, gửi lời chào anh chị em; Mác, anh em họ của Ba-na-ba, cũng vậy. Anh chị em đã nhận được lời dặn về anh ấy: nếu anh ấy đến với anh chị em, hãy tiếp đón anh ấy. \v 11 Giê-xu, cũng gọi là Giu-tu, cũng chào anh chị em. Trong tất cả các tín hữu người Do Thái, chỉ có những người này cùng làm việc với tôi cho vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, và họ đã là niềm an ủi lớn cho tôi.
vi.R: A-ri-tạc, người đang ở tù với tôi, gửi lời chào anh chị em. Mác, anh em họ của Ba-na-ba, cũng vậy. Anh chị em đã được dặn phải làm gì với Mác: nếu anh ấy đến với anh chị em, hãy tiếp đón anh ấy. \v 11 Giê-xu, cũng gọi là Giu-tu, cũng gửi lời chào anh chị em. Ba người này là những tín hữu người Do Thái duy nhất đang cùng làm việc với tôi để loan báo về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời. Họ đã là niềm an ủi lớn cho tôi.

ko.L: 나와 함께 갇힌 아리스다고가 여러분에게 문안합니다. 바나바의 사촌 마가도 [문안합니다]. 여러분은 그에 관하여 지시를 받았으니, 그가 여러분에게 가거든 그를 맞아들이십시오. \v 11 유스도라고 하는 예수도 [문안합니다]. 할례받은 사람들 가운데서는 이들만이 하나님 나라를 위한 나의 동역자들이며, 이들은 내게 위로가 되었습니다.
ko.B: 나와 함께 갇혀 있는 아리스다고가 여러분에게 문안합니다. 바나바의 사촌 마가도 문안합니다. 마가에 대해서는 여러분이 이미 지시를 받았을 것입니다. 그가 여러분에게 가거든 따뜻하게 맞아 주십시오. \v 11 유스도라고 불리는 예수도 여러분에게 문안합니다. 유대인 신자들 가운데 하나님 나라를 위해 나와 함께 일하는 사람은 이들뿐이며, 이들은 나에게 큰 위로가 되었습니다.
ko.R: 나와 함께 감옥에 있는 아리스다고가 여러분에게 안부를 전합니다. 바나바의 사촌 마가도 안부를 전합니다. 마가에 대해서는 여러분이 어떻게 해야 할지 이미 들었을 것입니다. 마가가 여러분에게 가거든 반갑게 맞아 주십시오. \v 11 유스도라고도 하는 예수도 안부를 전합니다. 유대인 신자 가운데 하나님 나라의 소식을 전하는 일에 나와 함께 일하는 사람은 이 세 사람뿐입니다. 이들은 나에게 큰 위로가 되었습니다.

pt.L: Aristarco, meu companheiro de prisão, saúda vocês, e Marcos, o primo de Barnabé (a respeito de quem vocês receberam instruções: se ele vier até vocês, recebam-no), \v 11 e Jesus, chamado Justo. Estes, dentre os da circuncisão, [são os] únicos cooperadores para o Reino de Deus, [e eles] têm sido um consolo para mim.
pt.B: Aristarco, meu companheiro de prisão, manda saudações a vocês, e também Marcos, o primo de Barnabé. Vocês já receberam instruções a respeito dele: se ele for visitá-los, recebam-no bem. \v 11 Jesus, chamado Justo, também manda saudações. Dos irmãos na fé que são judeus, só estes trabalham comigo pelo Reino de Deus, e eles têm sido um grande consolo para mim.
pt.R: Aristarco, que está preso comigo, manda um abraço. Marcos, o primo de Barnabé, também. Vocês já sabem o que fazer com relação a Marcos: se ele for até vocês, deem boas-vindas a ele. \v 11 Jesus, que também é chamado Justo, também manda um abraço. Esses três são os únicos irmãos judeus que estão trabalhando comigo para espalhar as notícias do Reino de Deus. Eles têm sido um grande consolo para mim.

am.L: ከእኔ ጋር የታሰረው አርስጥሮኮስ ሰላም ይላችኋል፤ የበርናባስ የአጎት ልጅ ማርቆስም፣ (ስለ እርሱ ትእዛዝ ተቀብላችኋል፤ ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ ተቀበሉት)፣ \v 11 ኢዮስጦስ የተባለው ኢየሱስም [ሰላም ይላችኋል]። ከተገረዙት ወገን እነዚህ ብቻ ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት አብረውኝ የሚሠሩ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም መጽናኛ ሆነውልኛል።
am.B: ከእኔ ጋር እስረኛ የሆነው አርስጥሮኮስ ሰላምታ ይልክላችኋል፤ የበርናባስ የአጎት ልጅ ማርቆስም እንዲሁ። ስለ እርሱ መመሪያ ተቀብላችኋል፤ ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ በደስታ ተቀበሉት። \v 11 ኢዮስጦስ የተባለው ኢየሱስም ሰላምታ ይልክላችኋል። ካመኑት አይሁድ መካከል ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከእኔ ጋር የሚሠሩት እነዚህ ብቻ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ታላቅ መጽናኛ ሆነውልኛል።
am.R: ከእኔ ጋር በእስር ቤት ያለው አርስጥሮኮስ ሰላም ይላችኋል። የበርናባስ የአጎት ልጅ ማርቆስም ሰላም ይላችኋል። ስለ ማርቆስ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለባችሁ አስቀድሞ ተነግሯችኋል፤ ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ ተቀበሉት። \v 11 ኢዮስጦስ ተብሎ የሚጠራው ኢየሱስም ሰላም ይላችኋል። የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ወሬ ለማዳረስ ከእኔ ጋር ከሚሠሩት አማኞች መካከል አይሁድ የሆኑት እነዚህ ሦስቱ ብቻ ናቸው። ታላቅ መጽናኛ ሆነውልኛል።

decisions.choice: Aristarchus: a Macedonian from Thessalonica who traveled with Paul
decisions.reason: Aristarchus was with Paul at Ephesus and on the voyage to Rome (Acts 19:29; 20:4; 27:2), and is named in Philemon 24.

decisions.choice: fellow prisoner: sharing Paul's captivity
alternatives: a fellow soldier, 'captured' by Christ (a figure of speech)
decisions.reason: συναιχμάλωτός means a fellow captive, at first a prisoner of war. Aristarchus may have shared Paul's imprisonment, or chosen to stay with him; in Philemon 23 the same word is used of Epaphras.

decisions.choice: Mark, the cousin of Barnabas
decisions.reason: John Mark left Paul and Barnabas partway through their first journey, and Paul later refused to take him again, which parted Paul and Barnabas (Acts 13:13; 15:37-39). Here he is back among Paul's fellow workers (Philemon 24; compare 2 Timothy 4:11).

decisions.choice: the instructions: earlier word about Mark, and now "welcome him"
decisions.reason: The Colossians had already been told about Mark in some way the letter does not explain. The words "if he comes to you, welcome him" may be those instructions, or Paul's own request now.

decisions.choice: the only Jewish believers among Paul's fellow workers
alternatives: these are the only ones who are Jews
decisions.reason: οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς ("those of the circumcision") are Jewish believers. Paul means that of the Jewish believers, only these three are working with him where he is; the other fellow workers named next are Gentiles.

decisions.choice: comfort: encouragement and relief
decisions.reason: παρηγορία is found only here in the New Testament. It means comfort, relief, consolation.

decisions.choice: Balanced and Readable say "greets you" for each name and split the sentence
decisions.reason: The Greek has one verb for three people; repeating it keeps the list clear.

decisions.choice: says hello
decisions.reason: Readable uses everyday words for a greeting.

decisions.choice: "Giê-xu, cũng gọi là Giu-tu", without the honorific "Đức"
decisions.reason: This is another man of the same name, one of Paul's fellow workers. The book gives the Lord the honorific "Đức Giê-xu" at every level, so leaving it off here keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: "anh em họ" for "cousin"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese kinship words say which side of the family and which generation; the Greek word says only that they were cousins, so "anh em họ", the general word, leaves the rest open.

decisions.choice: "유스도라고 하는 예수", with no honorific
decisions.reason: This Jesus is another man, a Jewish believer with Paul, who shares the common name. Korean names him as the Greek does, and gives him the plain forms used for every other person in these greetings ("예수도 문안합니다"), so the honorific does not suggest he is the Lord.

decisions.choice: "문안하다" (L, B); "안부를 전하다" (R), through these greetings
decisions.reason: "문안하다" is the formal word for sending greetings in a letter; Readable uses the everyday "안부를 전하다", as the English Readable says "says hello".

decisions.choice: manda um abraço
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday Brazilian close of a letter for sending greetings, as the English Readable says "says hello"; "diz olá" is a calque. Literal says "saúda", Balanced "manda saudações".

decisions.choice: Jesus, chamado Justo
decisions.reason: The Greek name is the same as the Lord's, and the English keeps "Jesus", and Portuguese does the same; it is a common Jewish name of the time (Joshua). "Justo" is the Portuguese form of the Latin surname.

decisions.choice: አርስጥሮኮስ (Aristarchus); በርናባስ (Barnabas); ኢዮስጦስ (Justus)
decisions.reason: The forms used in Acts. "Jesus who is called Justus" keeps the name "ኢየሱስ", as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: ሰላም ይላችኋል (greets you, L, R); ሰላምታ ይልክላችኋል (sends you greetings, B), here and in 4:12 and 4:14
decisions.reason: As in Romans 16: Literal keeps the plain greeting verb; Balanced says what a greeting in a letter does; Readable follows the English Readable's "says hello".

source.text: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν, δοῦλος Χριστοῦ, πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς, ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Greets you Epaphras the [one] of you, a slave of Christ, always struggling on behalf of you in the prayers, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in all [the] will of the God.

en.L: Epaphras, who is one of you, a slave of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, greets you, always struggling for you in [his] prayers, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.
en.B: Epaphras, one of your own and a servant of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, sends you greetings. He always wrestles for you in his prayers, asking that you will stand firm, mature and fully sure of everything God wills.
en.R: Epaphras, who is from your town, says hello. He is a servant of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. He always prays hard for you. He asks God to help you stand strong, grown up in your faith and completely sure of all that God wants.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saluda Epafras, que es uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, esclavo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, siempre luchando por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en [sus] oraciones, para que {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} firmes, maduros y plenamente seguros en toda la voluntad de Dios.
es.B: Epafras, que es uno de los {{plural_you:suyos|vuestros}} y siervo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} envía saludos. Siempre lucha por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en sus oraciones, pidiendo que {{plural_you:se mantengan|os mantengáis}} firmes, maduros y del todo seguros de todo lo que Dios quiere.
es.R: Epafras, que es de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} ciudad, {{plural_you:les|os}} manda saludos. Es siervo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. Siempre ora con todas sus fuerzas por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Le pide a Dios que {{plural_you:los|os}} ayude a estar firmes, maduros en la fe y completamente seguros de todo lo que Dios quiere.

fr.L: Épaphras, qui est des vôtres, esclave du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, vous salue, luttant toujours pour vous dans [ses] prières, afin que vous teniez ferme, accomplis et pleinement convaincus dans toute la volonté de Dieu.
fr.B: Épaphras, l’un des vôtres, serviteur du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, vous salue. Il combat toujours pour vous dans ses prières, demandant que vous teniez ferme, mûrs et pleinement assurés de tout ce que Dieu veut.
fr.R: Épaphras, qui est de votre ville, vous salue. C’est un serviteur du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Il prie toujours avec ardeur pour vous. Il demande à Dieu de vous aider à rester forts, adultes dans votre foi et tout à fait sûrs de tout ce que Dieu veut.

sw.L: Epafra, aliye wa kwenu, mtumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, anawasalimu, siku zote akishindana kwa ajili yenu katika maombi [yake], ili msimame mkiwa mmekomaa na mkiwa na uhakika kamili katika mapenzi yote ya Mungu.
sw.B: Epafra, aliye mmoja wenu na mtumishi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, anawasalimu. Siku zote anapigana kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu katika maombi yake, akiomba msimame imara, mkiwa mmekomaa na mkiwa na hakika kamili juu ya yote anayoyataka Mungu.
sw.R: Epafra, ambaye ni wa mji wenu, anawasalimu. Yeye ni mtumishi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Siku zote anawaombea kwa bidii sana. Anamwomba Mungu awasaidie msimame imara, mkue katika imani yenu, na muwe na uhakika kamili wa yote ambayo Mungu anataka.

vi.L: Ê-pháp-ra, là một người trong anh chị em, nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, chào anh chị em; anh ấy luôn luôn chiến đấu vì anh chị em trong những lời cầu nguyện, để anh chị em đứng vững, trưởng thành và hoàn toàn tin chắc trong mọi ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Ê-pháp-ra, người đồng hương với anh chị em và là đầy tớ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, gửi lời chào anh chị em. Anh ấy luôn luôn vật lộn vì anh chị em trong lời cầu nguyện, xin cho anh chị em đứng vững, trưởng thành và hoàn toàn chắc chắn về mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời muốn.
vi.R: Ê-pháp-ra, người ở thành của anh chị em, gửi lời chào anh chị em. Anh ấy là đầy tớ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Anh ấy luôn cầu nguyện tha thiết cho anh chị em. Anh ấy xin Đức Chúa Trời giúp anh chị em đứng vững, trưởng thành trong đức tin, và hoàn toàn chắc chắn về mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời muốn.

ko.L: 여러분 가운데 한 사람이요 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종인 에바브라가 여러분에게 문안합니다. 그는 여러분이 완전하고 확신에 차서 하나님의 모든 뜻 안에 서도록, 기도할 때마다 여러분을 위하여 항상 애써 싸우고 있습니다.
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 한 사람이며 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종인 에바브라가 여러분에게 문안합니다. 그는 늘 기도로 여러분을 위해 씨름하면서, 여러분이 성숙하고 하나님의 모든 뜻을 온전히 확신하며 굳게 서기를 구하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 여러분의 도시 출신인 에바브라가 안부를 전합니다. 그는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종입니다. 그는 언제나 여러분을 위해 힘써 기도합니다. 여러분이 굳게 서서 믿음이 자라고, 하나님께서 원하시는 모든 것을 완전히 확신하도록 도와주시기를 하나님께 구합니다.

pt.L: Epafras, que é um de vocês, escravo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, saúda vocês, sempre lutando por vocês nas [suas] orações, para que vocês permaneçam firmes, maduros e plenamente convictos em toda a vontade de Deus.
pt.B: Epafras, que é um de vocês e servo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, manda saudações. Ele sempre luta por vocês nas suas orações, pedindo que vocês permaneçam firmes, maduros e plenamente seguros de tudo o que Deus quer.
pt.R: Epafras, que é da cidade de vocês, manda um abraço. Ele é servo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. Ele sempre ora com muito empenho por vocês. Ele pede a Deus que ajude vocês a ficar firmes, maduros na fé e com toda a certeza de tudo o que Deus quer.

am.L: ከእናንተ ወገን የሆነው፣ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላም ይላችኋል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ፍጹማንና ሙሉ እርግጠኞች ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።
am.B: ከእናንተ ወገን የሆነውና {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ የሆነው ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ይልክላችኋል። እርሱ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል፤ የበሰላችሁና እግዚአብሔር በሚፈልገው ነገር ሁሉ ፍጹም እርግጠኞች ሆናችሁ ጸንታችሁ እንድትቆሙ ይለምናል።
am.R: ከእናንተ ከተማ የሆነው ኤጳፍራ ሰላም ይላችኋል። እርሱ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ ነው። ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ አጥብቆ ይጸልያል። በእምነታችሁ አድጋችሁና እግዚአብሔር የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ በፍጹም እርግጠኝነት አውቃችሁ ጸንታችሁ እንድትቆሙ እንዲረዳችሁ እግዚአብሔርን ይለምናል።

decisions.choice: a slave of Christ: one who belongs to Christ
decisions.reason: δοῦλος is the title Paul gives himself and Timothy in Philippians 1:1. Epaphras is wholly Christ's, as 1:7 has already said ("our fellow slave").

decisions.choice: struggling: hard effort, like an athlete's
decisions.reason: ἀγωνίζομαι is the verb of 1:29, from the word for the contest in 2:1. Epaphras's struggle for them is in prayer.

decisions.choice: stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God
alternatives: stand ... filled with all the will of God
decisions.reason: τέλειοι is the "mature" of 1:28. πεπληροφορημένοι means fully convinced, sure (Romans 4:21). Many manuscripts read a word meaning "filled" instead; the meaning is close. They are to know God's will and be sure of it (1:9).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "a slave of Christ"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "Christ Jesus". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: wrestles
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of physical effort (m2).

decisions.choice: akishindana (L); anapigana kwa bidii (B)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of a contest (m2). "Kujitahidi" (to make an effort) loses it; Readable says plainly that he prays hard.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that Epaphras belongs to Christ, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종" at every level
alternatives: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 섬기는 사람" in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The English has "slave" in Literal and "servant" in Balanced and Readable. Korean "종" already says that Epaphras belongs wholly to Christ without the picture of modern slavery, so the style guide keeps the one word at every level, as in 1:7.

decisions.choice: ባሪያ (slave) at Balanced and Readable as well
alternatives: አገልጋይ (servant), as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The style brief keeps "ባሪያ" for doulos at every level; meaning decision m1 says the word means one who belongs to Christ, which "አገልጋይ" would not say.

source.text: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱεραπόλει.

records.literal_gloss: I bear witness for to him that he has much toil on behalf of you and of those in Laodicea and of those in Hierapolis.

en.L: For I bear witness for him that he has much toil for you and for those in Laodicea and for those in Hierapolis.
en.B: I can vouch for him that he works hard for you and for the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
en.R: I can tell you that he works very hard for you and for the believers in the towns of Laodicea and Hierapolis.

es.L: Porque doy testimonio de él, que tiene mucha fatiga por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y por los de Laodicea y por los de Hierápolis.
es.B: Yo puedo dar fe de que él trabaja duro por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y por los creyentes de Laodicea y de Hierápolis.
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} aseguro que él trabaja muchísimo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y por los creyentes de las ciudades de Laodicea y Hierápolis.

fr.L: Car je lui rends témoignage qu’il se donne beaucoup de peine pour vous et pour ceux de Laodicée et pour ceux d’Hiérapolis.
fr.B: Je peux témoigner qu’il travaille dur pour vous et pour les croyants de Laodicée et d’Hiérapolis.
fr.R: Je peux vous dire qu’il travaille très dur pour vous et pour les croyants des villes de Laodicée et d’Hiérapolis.

sw.L: Kwa maana ninamshuhudia kwamba ana taabu nyingi kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya wale walio Laodikia na wale walio Hierapoli.
sw.B: Ninaweza kumshuhudia kwamba anafanya kazi kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya waumini wa Laodikia na Hierapoli.
sw.R: Ninawahakikishia kwamba anafanya kazi kwa bidii sana kwa ajili yenu, na kwa ajili ya waumini wa miji ya Laodikia na Hierapoli.

vi.L: Vì tôi làm chứng cho anh ấy rằng anh ấy chịu nhiều lao khổ vì anh chị em, vì những người ở Lao-đi-xê và vì những người ở Hi-ê-ra-pô-li.
vi.B: Tôi có thể làm chứng cho anh ấy rằng anh ấy làm việc vất vả vì anh chị em và vì các tín hữu ở Lao-đi-xê và Hi-ê-ra-pô-li.
vi.R: Tôi có thể nói với anh chị em rằng anh ấy làm việc rất vất vả cho anh chị em và cho các tín hữu ở các thành Lao-đi-xê và Hi-ê-ra-pô-li.

ko.L: 내가 그에 대하여 증언하는데, 그는 여러분과 라오디게아에 있는 사람들과 히에라볼리에 있는 사람들을 위하여 많은 수고를 하고 있습니다.
ko.B: 그가 여러분과 라오디게아와 히에라볼리의 신자들을 위해 많이 수고하고 있다는 것을 내가 보증합니다.
ko.R: 그가 여러분을 위해, 그리고 라오디게아와 히에라볼리라는 도시의 신자들을 위해 아주 열심히 일하고 있다는 것을 내가 말할 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Pois dou testemunho a respeito dele de que ele tem muito trabalho por vocês e pelos [que estão] em Laodiceia e pelos [que estão] em Hierápolis.
pt.B: Posso garantir que ele trabalha muito por vocês e pelos irmãos de Laodiceia e de Hierápolis.
pt.R: Posso dizer a vocês que ele trabalha muito por vocês e pelos irmãos na fé das cidades de Laodiceia e Hierápolis.

am.L: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያ ስላሉት በሄራፖሊስም ስላሉት ብዙ ድካም እንዳለው እመሰክርለታለሁና።
am.B: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያና በሄራፖሊስ ስላሉት አማኞች አጥብቆ እንደሚደክም እመሰክርለታለሁ።
am.R: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያና በሄራፖሊስ ከተሞች ስላሉት አማኞች በጣም እንደሚደክም ልነግራችሁ እችላለሁ።

decisions.choice: toil: hard, painful labor
decisions.reason: πόνον is labor that costs effort and pain. Many manuscripts have a different word, "zeal", which may be a copyist's replacement for an unusual word; the SBLGNT has πόνον.

decisions.choice: Laodicea and Hierapolis: the neighboring towns of the Lycus valley
decisions.reason: Laodicea lay about ten miles from Colossae (2:1), and Hierapolis a few miles north of Laodicea. Epaphras seems to have brought the gospel to all three towns (1:7).

decisions.choice: the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis
alternatives: those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "those in" these towns are: the churches there.

decisions.choice: ሄራፖሊስ (Hierapolis)
decisions.reason: A plain transliteration of the town's name, easier for readers to place than the older divided form.

source.text: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Greets you Luke the physician the beloved, and Demas.

en.L: Luke the beloved physician greets you, and Demas.
en.B: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, sends you greetings, and so does Demas.
en.R: Luke, the doctor, whom we love, says hello. So does Demas.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saluda Lucas, el médico amado, y Demas.
es.B: Nuestro querido amigo Lucas, el médico, {{plural_you:les|os}} envía saludos, y también Demas.
es.R: Lucas, el médico, a quien amamos, {{plural_you:les|os}} manda saludos. También Demas.

fr.L: Luc, le médecin bien-aimé, vous salue, ainsi que Démas.
fr.B: Notre cher ami Luc, le médecin, vous salue, et Démas aussi.
fr.R: Luc, le médecin, que nous aimons, vous salue. Démas aussi.

sw.L: Anawasalimu Luka, daktari mpendwa, na Dema.
sw.B: Rafiki yetu mpendwa Luka, yule daktari, anawasalimu, na Dema pia.
sw.R: Luka, daktari tunayempenda, anawasalimu. Dema naye anawasalimu.

vi.L: Lu-ca, thầy thuốc yêu dấu, chào anh chị em, và Đê-ma [cũng vậy].
vi.B: Lu-ca, người bạn thân yêu của chúng ta, là bác sĩ, gửi lời chào anh chị em; Đê-ma cũng vậy.
vi.R: Lu-ca, người bác sĩ mà chúng tôi yêu mến, gửi lời chào anh chị em. Đê-ma cũng vậy.

ko.L: 사랑받는 의사 누가와 데마가 여러분에게 문안합니다.
ko.B: 우리의 사랑하는 친구인 의사 누가가 여러분에게 문안하고, 데마도 문안합니다.
ko.R: 우리가 사랑하는 의사 누가가 안부를 전합니다. 데마도 안부를 전합니다.

pt.L: Lucas, o médico amado, saúda vocês, e Demas.
pt.B: O nosso querido amigo Lucas, o médico, manda saudações a vocês, e Demas também.
pt.R: Lucas, o médico, a quem amamos, manda um abraço. Demas também.

am.L: የተወደደው ሐኪሙ ሉቃስና ዴማስ ሰላም ይሏችኋል።
am.B: ውድ ወዳጃችን ሐኪሙ ሉቃስ ሰላምታ ይልክላችኋል፤ ዴማስም እንዲሁ።
am.R: የምንወደው ሐኪሙ ሉቃስ ሰላም ይላችኋል። ዴማስም ሰላም ይላችኋል።

decisions.choice: Luke the physician
decisions.reason: Luke is named among Paul's fellow workers in Philemon 24 and 2 Timothy 4:11. Only here are we told he was a doctor. Early church tradition names him as the author of the Gospel of Luke and Acts.

decisions.choice: Demas
decisions.reason: Demas is one of Paul's fellow workers in Philemon 24. 2 Timothy 4:10 later says he left Paul, "having loved this present world".

decisions.choice: the doctor
decisions.reason: Everyday English.

decisions.choice: "thầy thuốc" (L); "bác sĩ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Thầy thuốc" is the general word for one who heals and suits the ancient setting at Literal; "bác sĩ" is the everyday word for a doctor, as the English Balanced and Readable say "doctor".

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐκκλησίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Greet the in Laodicea brothers and Nympha and the in [the] house of her church.

en.L: Greet the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her house.
en.B: Give my greetings to the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.
en.R: Say hello for me to the believers in Laodicea. Also say hello to Nympha and to the church that meets in her home.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "Nympha and the church in her house"
alternatives: "Nymphas and the church in his house"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ over whether this person is a woman, Nympha ("her house"), or a man, Nymphas ("his house"); some read "their house". The name's form in Greek can be either. The SBLGNT reads "her", found in some important early manuscripts; a copyist might more easily have changed a woman's name to a man's than the reverse.

decisions.choice: the church in her house: a congregation that met in a home
decisions.reason: The first churches met in houses, often of a believer who had room and means (Romans 16:5; Philemon 2). Nympha was the host, and perhaps the leader, of such a church, probably in Laodicea or near it.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The church in Laodicea included women and men. Readable says "the believers", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: the church that meets in her house
decisions.reason: The church is the people, not the building; "meets" says so.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters (as in Philippians 4:1), so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: Ninfa ... su casa
decisions.reason: Spanish "su" does not show whether the house is a woman's or a man's, so the text variant (m1) shows only in the name: "Ninfa" is a woman's name, following the SBLGNT.

decisions.choice: l’église, lowercase, for the congregation in Nympha's house and in Laodicea (4:15-16)
decisions.reason: As set out at 1:18, the capital is kept for the church as Christ's body; a local gathering of believers is "l’église". French "sa maison" does not show whether the owner is a woman, so Readable says "chez elle", following the reading chosen in m1.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" means brothers and sisters alike, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: Nimfa ... nyumbani mwake / kwake
decisions.reason: Swahili possessives do not mark gender, so the text variant (m1) shows only in the name, given in its woman's form, Nimfa, following the SBLGNT.

decisions.choice: {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} (L, B); "các tín hữu" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's span for adelphoi meaning believers, as in 1:2; Readable says "the believers", as the English Readable does and as the Vietnamese John does at 21:23.

decisions.choice: "bà" for Nympha ("nhà bà")
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must choose a word for her by age and standing, which the Greek does not give. A woman who hosts a church in her house is spoken of with respect, so "bà"; a reviewer may prefer "chị". The text follows the SBLGNT reading that Nympha is a woman (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 (L, B); "믿는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The church in Laodicea included women and men, so the default is "형제자매" with "형제" as the traditional form. Readable says "믿는 사람들" (believers), which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "그의 집" for "her house"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "her" (the meaning decision), and Nympha is a woman. Korean "그" is used of a woman as well as a man, and "그녀" is a written coinage that sounds out of place read aloud; "그 여자" would sound cold. The pronoun does not say "his", so it does not choose the other reading.

decisions.choice: Ninfa ... na casa dela
decisions.reason: As the text followed in m1, a woman's name with "her house". Portuguese "Ninfa" and "dela" make the woman plain, as the English "Nympha" and "her" do.

decisions.choice: ንምፋ (Nympha), with the feminine "በቤቷ" (in her house)
decisions.reason: The text follows SBLGNT's "her house" (meaning decision m1), so the name is a woman's and the possessive is feminine.

decisions.choice: read: read aloud to the gathered church
decisions.reason: ἀναγινώσκω means read, and letters were read aloud to the assembly (1 Thessalonians 5:27). Most believers heard Paul's letters rather than reading them.

decisions.choice: the letter from Laodicea: a letter we do not have
decisions.reason: This is most likely a letter of Paul's sent to Laodicea, to be passed on to Colossae. It has not survived, unless it is a letter we know by another name: some think of Ephesians, which may have gone to several churches, and some of Philemon. The letter does not say, so no identification is certain.

decisions.choice: send it to the church in Laodicea
alternatives: see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans
decisions.reason: Readable says how the letter would be read there: by sending it on.

decisions.choice: መልእክት (letter, L, B); ደብዳቤ (R)
decisions.reason: "መልእክት" is the word for an apostle's letter read to the church; Readable uses the everyday "ደብዳቤ", as Romans 1:1 does.

decisions.choice: Archippus: a member of the household church in Philemon's home
decisions.reason: Philemon 2 greets "Archippus our fellow soldier" with Philemon and Apphia and the church in their house. The letter does not say what his task was.

decisions.choice: the ministry received in the Lord: a work of service given him by the Lord
decisions.reason: διακονίαν means service of any kind, often service in the church (Acts 6:4; 2 Timothy 4:5). παραλαμβάνω is the verb used in 2:6 for receiving what is handed on. Paul tells the whole church to remind him, so his task concerned them.

decisions.choice: the work the Lord gave you to do
alternatives: the ministry you received in the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable puts "ministry" in plain words.

decisions.choice: uliyokabidhiwa
decisions.reason: παρέλαβες is receiving what is handed on (m2); "kukabidhiwa", to be entrusted with, says so.

decisions.choice: "anh" for Archippus; "chức vụ" (L, B), "công việc" (R) for the ministry
decisions.reason: The words are a message passed on by the church to a fellow member, so the plain respectful "anh". "Chức vụ" is the church word for a task of service; Readable says "work", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Paul's word to Archippus in 합쇼체 ("완수하십시오")
decisions.reason: The message is Paul's, passed on by the whole church in its gathering, so it keeps the speech level of the rest of the letter. A plain 해라체 command would make it sound like a rebuke, which the Greek does not say.

decisions.choice: você
decisions.reason: The words to Archippus are singular: one man addressed through the church, so Portuguese uses "você", as between people throughout the letter; "tu" is kept for address to God.

decisions.choice: አርክጳ (Archippus), addressed with the singular አንተ
decisions.reason: The established Amharic form of the name; the message is to one man, so the verbs inside the quotation are singular.

decisions.choice: Paul signs the letter in his own hand
decisions.reason: Paul usually dictated his letters to someone who wrote them down (Romans 16:22), and then added a greeting in his own handwriting as a mark that the letter was his (1 Corinthians 16:21; Galatians 6:11; 2 Thessalonians 3:17).

en.B: Remember that I am in chains.
en.R: Remember me, because I am a prisoner.

fr.R: Souvenez-vous de moi, car je suis prisonnier.

vi.L: Hãy nhớ đến xiềng xích của tôi.

vi.R: Hãy nhớ đến tôi, vì tôi đang ở tù.

ko.B: 내가 사슬에 매여 있다는 것을 기억해 주십시오.

pt.R: Lembrem-se de mim, porque estou preso.

decisions.choice: remember my chains: pray for me and keep faith with me in my imprisonment
decisions.reason: μνημονεύω is more than calling to mind: it is to remember someone in prayer and care (Hebrews 13:3). Paul's chains are for the gospel (verse 3).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: no "Amen" at the end
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "Amen", as copyists often did at the end of a book.

decisions.choice: the grace: God's grace, which the letter has spoken of
decisions.reason: The article points to the grace already named in the letter: God's grace in Christ (1:2, 1:6). Paul's letters close with a wish for it.

decisions.choice: May God's grace
decisions.reason: Readable makes the closing a prayer and says whose grace it is (m2).
